title: I made this game that fucks with your brain a little!
author: BeingComfortablyDumb
selftext:
Hey guys!

I wanted to share this game I built. It's an endless runner with a cool new twist that inverts the controls randomly as you keep running.

I like challenging games so I built something I'd like to play myself and for others who also like games that test their patience.

I built this game earlier using Claude and GPT earlier, then used Astra to give it a visual upgrade recently. Astra generated the assets using Meshy AI, Mixamo and Blender. Autonomously applied all the changes and updated the UI with a little back and forth in chat with me. With the right integrations in place, it's crazy how capable Astra is given the right directions. 

It's live on both stores. Please check it out and let me know how your experience was.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/invertia-endless-runner/id6789579765

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.mythicmotion.invertia
